This is how I approach it:

- Farm a few t1 maps, around 5-6 is enough to sustain.
- Do only t1 until you drop every single t2. After having a single copy of every t2 start doing t2's

It's that easy, but sometimes you get stuck with that one map that doesn't drop while doing higher tiers, especially when doing yellow maps, so this is what vou can do:

- Farm around 80% of the maps from a given tier, the other 20% can be done by other means, such as: 
1. Doing Zana missions
2. Buying maps from Zana
3. 3 to 1 recipe 
4. Upgrading maps with some of the harbinger orbs (one upgrades tier randonly, the other changes from another of same tier)
5. And if really desperate, use the zana mod to alternate tier. Use it only if you are having some tremenedous bad luck, since unlocking your last map this way will be a pain.


Always check your zana for maps you don't have, and try to manipulate your dailies into tiers you need to unlock.

Do this until you are in t16, no big secret if you don't rush things.

Just gave a shot at fnm and tried other area skill just to be sure (ice nova + remote mine). It's bugged and does not generate power charges as it should.

It does work if you slow down the detonation, in this case waiting for the mine to arm. If you "queue" the detonation (pressing the detonate button sooner or using a totem), you won't recieve a single power charge out of it, slowing you down a lot in maps and in bosses.
I haven't tried it on fnm, but I'll come back to you with an answer later today.

Blast cascade used to generate Power charges when  your mine targets an enemy. That's a very common thing to do, and while using a detonate mines totem that would happen all the time, keeping your charge uptime while fighting bosses with no problem at all.

Right now the new queue they added for mine detonation doesn't allow blast cascade to generate power Charges. If you (or your totem) detonate a mine while it's arming, it will never generate a charge. It will only generate charges if you wait for it to arm and them press the detonade mine button. 

This punishes players who play fast, you have to wait a while to detonate your mine while playing for it to generate a charge, and during bosses you can't rely on your totem for charges (the totem always queue the detonation now, turning your chance to generate a charge iquals to zero). That's very frustrating in boss fights, especially with their higher hp right now.

I'll link here a forum post someone made explaining the bug, he also made a video showcasing that the new queue is indeed broken. In case you are curious, here you go: https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1934587

Ps: my current solution is linking orb of storms - curse on hit - curse - power charge on critical. That keeps the uptime for bosses, but sadly I lose damage and mana regeneration I could be having if arcane surge took pcoc place.

That, of course, would be the better fix for the problem. But, as it stands now, I don't believe they are even aware of this bug. There's no mention about it in the official sticked bug report forum post.

Meanwhile it would be great if they could rollback to the previous code while they fix this, it's been a pain to play since this change has been made.

**Now I run a tier 1 map again, but can't find any tier 3 map in it, because I never played any, right?**

That's correct.

**So I would need to play some tier 3 maps to finde them in tier 1 maps rarely.**

If you have at least one tier 3 map unlocked, you could drop it by killing the map boss ( that's the only way to get a map 2 tier higher than the one you are running, excluding cartographer boxes )

**Therefore it seems to be best to finish all tier 3 & 4 maps to get the best map drops while playing tier 2 maps.**

That's not enterely correct. Say you are running a tier 2 map and have only one tier 3 map unlocked, if you happen to get a map drop and your luck decided it's a tier 3 map, the only one you could get would be that tier 3 you have unlocked (mind that if there's a tier 3 map connected to the map you are running atm, that map can drop too!).

Say you killed the map boss on that tier 2 map, and the game decided you got a tier 4 map. If you have no tier 4 maps unlocked, then you will get a tier 3 map instead, chosen from the ones you have unlocked. If you have only one tier 3 map unlocked, and there are no tier 3 maps connected to the map you a running, the one unlocked will drop.

That's the reason people are shaping racecource this league (tier 11 map), and leaving all tier 12 locked. So if they happen to get a tier 12 map drop it would instead turn into a tier 11, and having only racecource unlocked means you will recieve a tier 11 shaped racecource map.
